idea-plugin.name: TLS Cert Lifetime Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the 12 settings that break when public TLS certificates fall to 100 days on 2027-03-15: openssl -days, Terraform, cert-manager, late expiry alerts, HPKP, TLS 1.0/1.1, SHA-1, RSA-1024.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → TLS Cert Lifetime Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 12 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/tls-cert-lifetime-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/tls-cert-lifetime-lint

action.text: TLS Cert Lifetime Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run TLS Cert Lifetime Lint on the file in the editor
